title: LandlordGuard Member Tenure Credit on Vacancy Permits
content:
Larkspur Mutual credits a landlord's continuous time with the carrier on a building insured under the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy when it prices a vacancy permit on that building.

**Credit.** A policy whose original effective date is at least 84 whole months before the request date takes 5 points off the permit rate percentage; one insured at least 36 but fewer than 84 whole months takes 2 points off; one insured fewer than 36 whole months takes nothing off.

The points are percentage points taken off the permit rate percentage of the permit being requested, before that rate is applied, once, in the charge.

| Whole months from the original effective date to the request date | Tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 84 or more | 5 points off |
| 36 to 83 | 2 points off |
| fewer than 36 | none |

The original effective date is the policy's first inception date on this building, not the start of the current term.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates)

| Original effective date | Request date | Whole months | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2018 | 28 February 2025 | 83 | 2 points off |
| 1 March 2018 | 1 March 2025 | 84 | 5 points off |
| 10 June 2022 | 9 June 2025 | 35 | none |
| 10 June 2022 | 10 June 2025 | 36 | 2 points off |
